_comment: Coloring-page prompt axes. styles = shape language / aesthetic ONLY (never line thickness, background or fills — those belong to system.md and lineWeights). aliases map the frontend's kebab-case keys onto style ids.

styles.simple_outline: minimal clean line art with simple, easy-to-recognize shapes, beginner-friendly coloring page, low detail count, large open fillable regions and clear silhouettes
styles.bold_and_easy: very simple flat shapes with oversized fillable areas, extremely low detail count, no tiny interior lines, easy coloring page suitable for very young children or seniors
styles.chunky: chunky inflated illustration style, forms look soft, rounded and squeezable like plush toys, puffy balloon-like volumes with no sharp corners
styles.sticker: die-cut sticker style with a strong, clear silhouette suitable for cutting out, simple flat iconic shapes, playful and decorative
styles.kawaii: kawaii cute style with rounded chubby proportions, large round simple eyes each with a small highlight circle, tiny dot nose, small curved smiling mouth, gentle friendly expression
styles.cartoon: classic Western cartoon style with expressive, exaggerated features, confident inked outlines, lively dynamic poses, retro Saturday-morning animation aesthetic and stylized proportions
styles.chibi: chibi style with oversized head and small stubby body, very large expressive eyes each with a highlight circle, short rounded limbs, tiny nose and mouth, overall super-cute proportions
styles.classic: classic picture-book illustration style, warm storybook feel reminiscent of traditional children's books, natural organic shapes with a gentle hand-drawn quality

lineWeights.thin: THIN, fine outlines like a sharp fine-liner pen (~0.3 mm). Narrow stroke so small interior details stay readable. Uniform width throughout — same thickness on body outlines and interior details, no tapering.
lineWeights.medium: MEDIUM-WEIGHT outlines like a standard felt-tip pen (~0.7 mm). Confident and clear; prints cleanly without feeling heavy. Uniform width throughout — same thickness on body outlines and interior details, no tapering.
lineWeights.thick: THICK, BOLD outlines like a broad permanent marker (~2 mm). Wide and dominant, easy for young children to follow. Uniform width throughout — same thickness on body outlines and interior details, no tapering.
